VBO:0201228.summary: Toy play and close companionship stand out in a firsthand rescue account of the Shiranian, a Shih Tzu–Pomeranian cross. Four-year-old Annie Mae shares a strong bond with her Pomeranian companion, Dana, and her carers describe her as cuddly and spirited. She can be shy with new people. The account records about three years in care and notes that the pair did not walk on leashes.
